camel_example: aliyun dyplsapi OperateAxgGroup --region cn-hangzhou --Numbers '1390000****,1380000****' --PoolKey 'FC10000012345****' --OperateType addNumbers --GroupId 2000012340000 --version 2017-05-25 --method POST --force
description_en: Modifies the phone numbers in a G number group by adding, deleting, or fully replacing them
description_zh: 修改G号码组中的号码，可以对号码进行添加、删除、全量替换操作
name: OperateAxgGroup

parameters.help_en:
The key of the number pool.

You can obtain the number pool key on the Number Pool Management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool) page in the Phone Number Privacy Protection console
parameters.help_zh:
号码池Key。

在号码隐私保护控制台，号码池管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool)页面获取号码池Key
parameters.name: pool_key

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the G group in AXG, which is the GID.

You can view the GID by using one of the following methods:
To view the GID, log on to the Phone Number Privacy Protection console, go to the Number Pool Management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool) page, filter for AXG Private Number, and then click G Number Group Management to view the GIDs of all G number groups.
If the G number group was created by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110250.html operation, the GroupID response parameter of the operation is the GroupID request parameter here.

A G number group must contain at least one phone number
parameters.help_zh:
AXG中的G组ID，即GID。

可以通过以下方式查看GID：
登录号码隐私保护控制台，在号码池管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool)页面筛选出AXG隐私号，单击G号码组管理即可查看所有G号码组的GID。
如果G号码组是通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110250.html创建的，则接口的返回参数**GroupID**就是此处的请求参数**GroupID**。

G号码组中必须有一个及以上的电话号码
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of operation to perform on the G number group. Valid values:
addNumbers: adds phone numbers.
deleteNumbers: deletes phone numbers.
overwriteNumbers: fully replaces phone numbers. All existing phone numbers in the G number group are deleted and new phone numbers are added.

You can add up to 200 phone numbers at a time.
When you fully replace phone numbers, the G number group can contain a maximum of 200 existing phone numbers
parameters.help_zh:
对G号码组的操作类型，取值：
addNumbers：添加号码。
deleteNumbers：删除号码。
overwriteNumbers：全量替换号码。会将G号码组中原有的电话号码全部删除，并重新添加号码。

每次添加号码时，最多添加200个号码。
全量替换号码时，G号码组中原有的号码不能超过200个
parameters.name: operate_type

parameters.help_en:
The phone numbers to be operated on.

Separate multiple phone numbers with commas (,). You can specify up to 200 phone numbers at a time.

If you set the OperateType parameter to addNumbers, the phone numbers specified by the Numbers parameter are added to the G number group.
If you set the OperateType parameter to deleteNumbers, the phone numbers specified by the Numbers parameter are deleted from the G number group.
If you set the OperateType parameter to overwriteNumbers, the existing phone numbers in the G number group are fully replaced with the phone numbers specified by the Numbers parameter
parameters.help_zh:
受到操作的电话号码。

多个号码之间用英文逗号（,）分隔，每次最多操作200个号码。

当OperateType参数指定为addNumbers时，将Numbers参数填写的电话号码添加到G号码组中。
当OperateType参数指定为deleteNumbers时，将Numbers参数填写的电话号码从G号码组中删除。
当OperateType参数指定为overwriteNumbers时，使用Numbers参数填写的电话号码全量替换G号码组中原有的电话号码
parameters.name: numbers

A value of OK indicates that the request is successful.

Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。
返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[错误码列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109196.html）
